# protoclim

## Overview

[protoclim](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/) is an R package for
determining the climatic suitability of plant species and is intended to
support risk assessors in performing a formal [pest risk
analysis](https://www.ippc.int/en/publications/592/).
[protoclim](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/) is heavily inspired
and influenced by the
[Proto3](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10530-017-1567-1)
technique developed and used by the United States Department of
Agriculture in their [Guidelines for the USDA-APHIS PPQ Weed Risk
Assessment
Process](https://www.aphis.usda.gov/sites/default/files/wra-guidelines.pdf).

[protoclim](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/) is designed to be
interoperable with any categorical climate variable but being inspired
by the Proto3 model is intended to be used with:

- Köppen-Geiger classes
- Precipitation bands
- Plant hardiness zones

Users *are* able to bring their own data but high-resolution global data
has already been currated for each of the above climate variables by the
associated repository
[`protoclimData`](https://github.com/CFIA-PDAM/protoclim) and is
available for download from
[Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/21400412). The climate variables are
available across present-day and future time periods as well as various
emission scenarios.

In addition to climate data, using
[protoclim](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/) requires species
occurrence data from GBIF, the Global Biodiversity Information Facility.
GBIF occurrence data can be downloaded from the [GBIF
website](https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/search?occurrenceStatus=present),
the [rgbif](https://docs.ropensci.org/rgbif) R package, or various other
means.

[protoclim](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/) comes with two
datasets:

1.  `bryonia_alba`, GBIF occurrence data for *Bryonia alba*, the white
    bryony

2.  `climate_layers_ssp370_2011_2040`, a lower-resolution version of the
    associated `.tif` file hosted on
    [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/21400412).

``` r

head(bryonia_alba)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   datasetName decimalLatitude decimalLongitude habitat            locality  year
#>   <chr>                 <dbl>            <dbl> <chr>              <chr>    <int>
#> 1 Artportalen            59.3             18.1 ""                 Skanskv…  2014
#> 2 Artportalen            59.0             18.3 "Snår vid vägen"   Utö vär…  2014
#> 3 Artportalen            57.2             12.2 ""                 Nyebro,…  1988
#> 4 Artportalen            57.2             12.2 ""                 Kärra, …    NA
#> 5 Artportalen            57.1             12.4 "häck i villaträd… Gödesta…  1993
#> 6 Artportalen            57.1             12.2 "grusmark"         Träslöv…    NA
```

``` r

# Note that a function is used to read the climate data
climate_layers_ssp370_2011_2040()
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 2088, 4320, 3  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.08333333, 0.08333333  (x, y)
#> extent      : -180.0001, 179.9999, -90.00014, 83.99986  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source      : climate_layers_ssp370_2011_2040.tif
#> colors rgb  : 1, 2, 3
#> names       : kgc_mode, pb_mode, phz_mode
#> min values  :        1,       1,        1
#> max values  :       30,      11,       28
```

## Installation

The easiest way to get
[protoclim](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/) is to install it
from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("protoclim")
```

### Development version

To get a bug fix or to use a feature from the development version, you
can install the development version of protoclim from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("CFIA-PDAM/protoclim")
```

## Usage

## Getting help

If you encounter a clear bug, please file an issue with a minimal
reproducible example on
[Github](https://github.com/CFIA-PDAM/protoclim/issues).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bryonia_alba`](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/reference/bryonia_alba.md)
  : GBIF occurrence data for Bryonia alba
- [`classify_cells()`](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/reference/classify_cells.md)
  : Classify each cell of climate data into suitability classes
- [`classify_layers()`](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/reference/classify_layers.md)
  : Classify each layer of climate data into suitability classes
- [`climate_layers_ssp370_2011_2040()`](https://cfia-pdam.github.io/protoclim/reference/climate_layers_ssp370_2011_2040.md)
  : Climate layers averaged over 2011 - 2040 under the SSP370 emission
  scenario
